mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_RESERVATION ( reservation_id, member_no, branch_dept_id, reserved_at, biz_type, purpose, status, created_at ) VALUES ( SEQ_TB_RESERVATION.NEXTVAL, #{dto.member_no}, #{dto.branch_dept_id}, #{dto.reserved_at}, #{dto.biz_type}, #{dto.purpose}, 'PENDING', SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT r.reservation_id, r.member_no, r.branch_dept_id, r.reserved_at, r.biz_type, r.purpose, r.status, r.created_at, r.updated_at, m.member_name AS member_name, d.dept_name AS branch_name FROM TB_RESERVATION r JOIN TB_BANK_MEMBER m ON r.member_no = m.member_no JOIN TB_DEPT d ON r.branch_dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE r.member_no = #{memberNo} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC

SELECT r.reservation_id, r.member_no, r.branch_dept_id, r.reserved_at, r.biz_type, r.purpose, r.status, r.created_at, r.updated_at, m.member_name AS member_name, d.dept_name AS branch_name FROM TB_RESERVATION r JOIN TB_BANK_MEMBER m ON r.member_no = m.member_no JOIN TB_DEPT d ON r.branch_dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE r.reservation_id = #{reservationId}
